matches.text: public static boolean claim(ServerPlayer p,BlockPos swordCase,InteractionHand hand){var s=get(p.serverLevel());var c=s.eligible.get(p.getUUID());if(hand!=InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND||!p.getMainHandItem().isEmpty()||s.claimed.contains(p.getUUID())||c==null||c.position()!=swordCase.asLong()||!s.cases.contains(c)||!valid(p,c,4)||p.getInventory().getFreeSlot()<0)return false;var sword=new ItemStack(ArtifactContent.ZHANLU.get());if(!p.getInventory().add(sword))return false;s.claimed.add(p.getUUID());s.eligible.remove(p.getUUID());s.setDirty();return true;}

public static boolean completeStage(ServerPlayer p,BlockPos swordCase,int stage){var t=TRIALS.get(p);long now=p.serverLevel().getGameTime();if(t==null||t.next()!=stage||stage<1||stage>3||t.swordCase().position()!=swordCase.asLong()||!valid(p,t.swordCase(),16)||now<t.born()||now-t.born()>1800)return false;if(stage<3)TRIALS.put(p,new Trial(t.swordCase(),stage+1,t.born()));else{TRIALS.remove(p);var s=get(p.serverLevel());s.eligible.put(p.getUUID(),t.swordCase());s.setDirty();}return true;}
